result.title: Algorithm Modelization: Transforming Optimization Algorithms into Evolvable Intelligence
result.summary: Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. We develop a dimension-independent population-temporal architecture to capture both population interactions and iterative dynamics, together with an imitation-to-surpassing learning framework that first acquires algorithmic knowledge from heterogeneous teachers and then improves the resulting optimizer directly through optimization feedback. The modelized optimizer consequently goes beyond reproducing individual algorithms: it consolidates heterogeneous search knowledge into a single trainable model, achieves stronger optimization capability through subsequent improvement, and generalizes its acquired knowledge across problems and substantially larger unseen dimensions. More fundamentally, Algorithm Modelization makes algorithmic capability accumulable through learning, where new algorithms and problem-solving experience can become training resources for progressively improving the model. Our results establish a promising path from manually designed algorithms toward general algorithm models that learn, generalize, and evolve from computational experience.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「Algorithm Modelization」，将迭代优化算法视为可训练模型：以算法执行轨迹为计算经验，用自回归过程建模种群与迭代动态，并设计维度无关的群体—时序架构和「先模仿异构教师、再依优化反馈超越」的训练框架，使所得优化器能合并异构搜索知识并泛化到更大维度的问题。
AI.relevance_reason: 把算法迭代状态当作可学习的自回归轨迹、并用维度无关架构泛化到未见规模，可能与 LVR 中推理状态如何逐步生成/更新、轨迹式训练监督及长度泛化的设计可供核查，但需确认其状态表示能否迁移到多模态推理。
